show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: REPLAY - David "Bull" Gurfein - Interdisciplinary Lessons from the Marines (Capital Allocators, EP.10)
summary:
This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Do people then start to question your leadership if you take that risk or it's your interpretation and you make, you know, the outcome is not what you would have liked? They should be brought aside, but never
punished because it does limit taking risk or chances or advancing going forward.
